## Release — backlog-campaign v0.23.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.23.0

#### Bundled shadcn/ui skill

- **Official shadcn/ui skill ships with every Blackhole install** — vendored from
  [`shadcn-ui/ui`](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui) at a pinned commit
  (`vendor/shadcn/`), including `SKILL.md` and its references (`cli.md`,
  composition rules, design-system workflow). `bun run build` copies it into
  each plugin `skills/shadcn/` tree.
- **Campaign workers load it for UI work** when the consumer repo has
  `components.json`. The project's `DESIGN.md` and Blackhole's design rubric
  stay authoritative over shadcn defaults.
- **`shadcn apply` / `init --preset` / theme or preset changes require the
  owner's explicit OK.** Component `add` / `search` / `docs` stay available.
- **Re-sync** with `bun run sync:shadcn` (optional `--commit <sha>`), matching
  the existing maintainer vendor-refresh path.
